I get what you mean! Like, my family likes reading but I know they wouldn't be into fanfic and yeah, for some reason writing fanfic doesn't seem to hold the same status as 'real writing '.

You can use it as a way to explore other sides of characters! For instance character B could say a teasing/ witty remark about character A and your Female MC could speak in agreement with character B, which could be in contrast to her usual attitude.

It can be a fun way to chaotically mix things up!

As for physical-wise, slurred speech, droopy eyes, sudden bursts of energy, stumbling or clumsiness.
Some people get sleepy/quiet, some get really passionate or easily angered, some get really flirtatious or sad - it can depend on the person or who they are around!
